My dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
A proof of the history of St Louis, I suppose [M.

Guizot](../persons.html#597)’s has come here, but I do not know the why or wherefore.

Is it a mistake?[^1]
[Mrs Valentine](../persons.html#1437) ([Mr Warne](../persons.html#1433)’s reader) says they do not know anything of having had '[Wooed and Won](../others.html#202)' sent in.

Perhaps you would kindly ask whoever was your messenger to whom he gave it

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
Would you kindly have both the [Cameos](../books.html#73) and [Historical Selections](../books.html#71) sent to [Madame de Witt](../persons.html#423)

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: Guizot contributed to Macmillan\'s [Sunday Library](../others.html#145) a volume entitled Great Christians of France: St.

Louis and Calvin (London: Macmillan 1868).
